title: A Shadow over Ashdale
start: Speak to Gudrik, who can be found east of Gerrant's Fishy Business in Port Sarim.

recommended.t: Decent armour, some food and a gem bag.
Ranged or Magic weapons to deal damage from a distance.

kills.t:
Several Crassian scouts (scales with your stats; some may be avoided)
• Agoroth (scales with your stats)

rewards.l: Attack XP lamp (A Shadow over Ashdale)
Defence XP lamp (A Shadow over Ashdale)
Constitution XP lamp (A Shadow over Ashdale)

rewards.t: May break one per day to receive bonus experience in any skill equal to that of a large fallen star

Access to the dead man's chest in the Ashdale Caves to repeat the battle against Agoroth, giving a black pearl (or coins) with bonus experience in any skill equal to that of a medium fallen star. This can be done once per week for free players or twice a week for members.

steps.t: To start, talk to Gudrik, east of Gerrant's Fishy Business in Port Sarim. [Chat: 1 Ask about A Shadow over Ashdale. › Accept]
Talk to him again. [Chat: 1 Can you take me to the island of Ashdale? › 1 Ashdale by night (A Shadow over Ashdale).]
Once you arrive at Ashdale, head north into Lucy's house to speak with her. [Chat: 1 I'm here to help. › 3 Why haven't you tried to leave?]
Enter the storm drain just west of the house.
Go through in the sewer, killing or running past crassians.
Climb up the ladder at the end of the sewer. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Run west, then south up the stairs. Continue south through Ashdale, through the gate and into the house.
Inspect the bust by the fireplace.
Climb down the staircase. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Ignore the crassians and enter the eastern room.
Pick up the valve outer wheel, valve inner wheel and pitch.
Repair the pipe on the ground.
Combine the valve parts to create a valve wheel.
Repair the socket on the central barrel.
Turn the valve wheel on the filled barrel, repeating this process on each of the barrels to move the water through the pipes to open the door.
Continue through and kill the crassian scouts in the next room to open the barrier.
Pull the lever to the south when the crassian warrior isn't looking.
Do the same with each crassian warrior guarding a lever to kill them.
Optionally loot the chests along the path for some coins and uncut gems.
Run past the scouts.
Climb on the ship.
Kill the 4 tentacles, moving to avoid their attacks.
Kill Agoroth, ideally from a distance.
Continue dialogue with Lucy and agree to return to Port Sarim. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Continue dialogue with Gudrik and ask for a reward. [Chat: 1 Ask about A Shadow over Ashdale. › 1 Is there a reward?]

sub.t: The reward requires seven free backpack spaces.

steps.t: Quest complete!
